purpose: Acquire verified public SPY/QQQ daily-close-plus-dividend cache at NY18:00, with a09:00HKT completeness gate before the unchanged Fee10:00/10:05 cycle.

acquisition.earlyClosePolicy: Use the reviewed13:00 session for completed-close eligibility and keep the conservativeNY18:00 acquisition target.
acquisition.retryRequires: Same target missing, no active benchmark run, one uniquely identified previous cloud run definitively failed, and the second acquisition hour is due.
acquisition.unknownDispatchOutcome: Preserve immutable claim; never retry thePOST or spend the second claim on an unresolved first attempt.
acquisition.successfulCacheReuse: Validate both ETF identities, raw-close/dividend schema, exact independently expected trading date and every actual session from the existing first row through the tail; fetch only incomplete ETF history, reject residual gaps before writing, and never fabricate dates before the first row.
acquisition.taskBudget: 600-second task timeout reserves240 seconds outside the360-second polling window for bounded metadata requests and runtime overhead. Extreme network stalls still terminate as a failed task under the existing alert.

unchangedBindings: Existing two metric policies and sole approved email channel

deadlineAndAlerting.readyRequires: Both actual last completed trading-session rows, matching expected identities and complete daily-price/dividend schema; workflow success alone is insufficient.
deadlineAndAlerting.secondDefiniteFailure: Fail the existing launcher task when observed; existing completed_task_attempt_count failed policy handles notification.
deadlineAndAlerting.notStartedOrUnobserved: Five minutes is the job-start age threshold; classify at the next successful metadata read after that threshold, including reused active runs. API delay and metric/email delivery add latency; never duplicate an unresolved request.
deadlineAndAlerting.deadlineMissing: The checker fails on missing, stale, malformed or mismatched cache; it cannot dispatch or alter prices.
deadlineAndAlerting.schedulerTargetFailure: Existing Scheduler ERROR-log metric policy remains in use.
deadlineAndAlerting.mailDeliveryTiming: 09:00 is the scheduled check time, not a guaranteed email arrival time; existing300-second metric alignment and provider delivery latency remain.
deadlineAndAlerting.jointAbsenceLimit: If both independent cloud Scheduler paths entirely fail to attempt, the existing later GitHub business-receipt watchdog is still the fallback. This proposal does not claim a strict09:00 whole-platform deadmanSLA.

calendar.unsupportedDate: Fail closed and alert; do not infer future calendars from missing prices or copyNYSE holidays into an unreviewed Nasdaq year.
calendar.renewal: Review the next official annual tables in one protected update before expiry; the shared manifest serves Python andJS.

feeBoundary.holidayFeeBehavior: The existing Fee valuation weekday contract is unchanged. A market holiday may therefore retain benchmark pending for that valuation date; the benchmark clock never relabels the preceding trading close as a holiday close.

costEstimateUsd.rateBasis: Same Hong Kong unit rates used by the Oct14 approved clock estimate; no free allowance assumed.
excludes: Unexpected duplicate deliveries or manual invocations

activationGates: Freeze complete code diff on latest main, finish offline validation and independent review, create actual signed candidate and obtain the human exact-head OWNER approval plus formal required checks before protected merge.
Build only the approved fixed source after code approval and record the immutable runtime image digest; no production build or deploy has occurred in this preparation.

Show the two Scheduler cron changes, both image/flag changes, launcher timeout and actual release digest for explicit activation approval. A goal agreement or code-head approval alone cannot authorize these production mutations.
Roll out outside the current Fee window, preserving every existing identity/Secret/IAM/alert binding; re-read resourceETags/configuration before controlled updates and after activation.
Accept the next natural primary/retry/deadline cycle from actual Scheduler, job, run and exact-cache-date/hash receipts. No manual financial or Fee producer run is part of acceptance.
